BrochureContent.Content:
31-35 Grosvenor Square comprises a three-storey block of 12 one bedroomed self-contained apartments of circa 45 sq.m. each, constructed in the mid 1970's on a site area of circa .39 acres. 

This property comes to the market with current occupancy of 8 units. There is off street resident parking to the rear with on street parking on Grosvenor Square. 

The property enjoys an almost unparalleled sense of convenience, situated on this popular residential road, easy access is afforded to all of the amenities that Rathmines & its' Town Centre has to offer to include food stores, restaurants and cafes. The villages of Rathgar and Rathmines and St Stephen's Green are all within a gentle stroll.
